reuse.why: Adds getRangedAmount to shared/schedules.ts and routes getScheduledAmount and every server site through it, but the sites keep their own number-vs-range dispatch instead of calling the existing getScheduledAmount, which already handles both.

duplication.why: The midpoint arithmetic is removed from all six places; the surrounding missing/number/range ternaries stay duplicated at the call sites.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to getScheduledAmount, the module both server and client already use for schedule amounts.

scope.why: Only the ranged-amount rule, a unit test and a release note.

maintainability.why: A future change to the rule is one edit; the two overlapping helpers (getRangedAmount and getScheduledAmount) and the per-site dispatch are a small wart.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedules/app.ts (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule and shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions keep their own typeof-number dispatch rather than calling the existing getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic is introduced; the remaining per-site ternaries are pre-existing and left as they were.

one_place.where: getRangedAmount in shared/schedules.ts decides the range rule; schedule-template, forecast-schedules, schedules/app (two sites), computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and getScheduledAmount (used by the client) all call it.
